states.description: Each search result is displayed as a card with: a provider-colored icon (left), title (bold, truncated), provider badge, relevance score percentage, optional CVSS badge, optional external link icon, and expandable content body. Results from different providers use different icon colors (DuckDuckGo=orange, Tavily=blue, Sploitus=red, Perplexity=purple, Local Cache=green).

states.description: The search flow: user types query → selects mode → clicks Search or presses Enter → loading spinner appears → results populate or error shows. Each search mode calls a different backend endpoint: web→/knowledge/search-web, error→/knowledge/research-error, vulnerability→/knowledge/search-vulnerabilities. After a successful search, the stats are automatically invalidated to reflect the new query.
states.precondition: Web Search mode is active and a query with ≥2 chars is entered

states.description: The stats widget (visible on both the Stats tab as full-size and embeddable elsewhere as compact) displays: a header with Brain icon, 'Knowledge Acquisition' title, and uptime; a 2x2 grid of stat cells (Total Searches, Cache Hit Rate, Results Stored, Cache Hits); an Active Providers section with success/query badges; and a prompt injection warning when detections > 0. Data auto-refreshes every 30 seconds.

states.description: The Knowledge Explorer follows the runner's established design system: card components use bg-card with border-border, text uses the foreground/muted-foreground hierarchy, stat values use tabular-nums for aligned digits, provider badges use text-[10px], and section headers use uppercase tracking-wider. All text is legible against its background in both light and dark themes.

states.description: The Knowledge Explorer can verify that the knowledge flywheel is working correctly by comparing stats before and after a search. A web search should increment total_searches, and if results are stored, results_ingested should increment. A subsequent identical search should show a cache hit if the flywheel stored the previous results.
states.precondition: A search has been performed and the Stats tab is viewed

description: Knowledge Explorer page — a two-tab interface for searching external knowledge sources (DuckDuckGo, Tavily, Sploitus, OSV.dev, Perplexity) and viewing system-wide knowledge acquisition statistics. The Search tab provides three search modes (Web, Error Research, Vulnerability) with result cards showing provider attribution, relevance scores, CVSS badges, and expandable content. The Stats tab displays a metrics dashboard with per-provider counters, cache hit rates, ingestion counts, and a provider availability grid.
